title: Detested by the Demon Lord
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mao, descended from an ancient demon lord, can command anyone he meets eye to eye and is ashamed of his lineage (Renta! blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). Kamiko, who claims to be the hero destined to defeat him, sets out to 'beat' him by taking his body, and the two end up living together in a bickering enemies-to-lovers comedy. Three volumes, adult cast.
life_message: Even someone ashamed of what he was born as can be wanted for who he is (to verify).
